for_ren: The Chinese ethics on the first screen (_process/navigation/README-ZH.md, now in three paragraphs) and on the one page: the anchor every Chinese front follows. It says 伦理从延续中生出; 生灭变化之外没有应当，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶; 自我关切 once, as a kind of order with its marking (自身的延续，这里读作自身所能到达的范围之内者); 未必把依存于它的那些也算进来; 要让选择因它们的损失而改变，就得看见它们，但看见还不够; 混合，不替任何人去权衡.

Four term choices now on every Chinese page: 世系 for the line that persists without end (not 谱系); 只是对已作选择的一道筛选，而不是一种已形成的次序 for 'a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed'; 算作活 for 'counted as living'; 重合 for two properties coinciding (相合 stays chapter 6's word for a passage's agreement).
